comments.comment: grammar.lalrpop's match block: r"#[^\n]*" — a line comment, newline excluded.

strings.comment: grammar.lalrpop's StringLitTok: "..." with \" / \n escapes; #{...} interpolation is a real, separate re-parse (crates/emerald-parser/src/interpolate.rs).
strings.name: string.quoted.double.emerald

symbols.comment: grammar.lalrpop's SymbolLitTok: :identifier, no space between ':' and the name.
symbols.name: constant.other.symbol.emerald

keywords.comment: Plan 71: 'def' -> 'fn'; 'case'/'when' are deleted outright in favor of 'match', with every arm (including the '_' wildcard default) now closed by its own 'do' ... 'end' — 'do' also becomes mandatory after if/unless/while/until/elsif's own condition, and introduces the bare do|params| ... end lambda literal (plan 10's arrow-lambda is gone). Coverage audit (this pass): this block had stopped at plan 71's own keyword set; restored parity with every literal keyword terminal grammar.lalrpop actually reserves since — 'var' (plan 72), 'newtype' (81), 'derive'/'comptime' (61), 'requires'/'ensures' (62), 'spawn' (54), 'remote' (60), 'locate' (65), 'supervise' (57), 'unsafe'/'extern' (59), 'own'/'borrow' (83), 'static' (196), 'export'/'import' (76), 'test'/'property'/'benchmark' (47/80), and the 'Ok'/'Err'/'Some'/'None' constructor keywords plans 53/73's Result/Option destructuring relies on — see grammar.lalrpop's own per-production comments for each citation.

constants.comment: Plan 73's Decision log: 'nil' was fully replaced by 'Option[T]'/'Some'/'None' and no longer appears as real keyword usage anywhere — dropped from this ground-truth list (dead syntax, comments-only).
constants.name: constant.language.emerald

types.comment: Array/Hash/Pair/Result/Proc are real grammar.lalrpop terminals (TypeName); Option (plan 73) and the rest are plain Ident tokens sema resolves as builtin type names, not grammar keywords — still given a distinct scope here since a TextMate grammar has no sema of its own to defer to.
types.name: support.type.emerald

patterns.comment: grammar.lalrpop's FloatLit: [0-9]+\.[0-9]+ — no exponent, no bare trailing dot.
patterns.name: constant.numeric.float.emerald

operators.comment: Every literal operator/punctuation terminal in grammar.lalrpop, longest first so e.g. '<=>' wins over '<=' wins over '<'. Plan 71: '->' is deleted from the grammar outright (every return-type position now uses ':') and is not matched here any more.
operators.name: keyword.operator.emerald
